# data/ — recorded Hugging Face results for a fixed prompt (generated by `python3 golden/golden_hf.py`)

**These are not the weights.** The weights are in `models/gpt2_124M.bin`. This
folder holds what the Hugging Face model *computed* for the prompt
"The FPGA is":
- the generated tokens;
- every intermediate value of one decode step (token 257 at position 5);
- the KV cache and the logits;
- the token IDs for a 992-token prompt.

All tests compare our code against these recorded answers. To regenerate them,
run `python3 golden/golden_hf.py`.

All files are raw little-endian arrays (C order); `manifest.txt` lists
`file dtype shape`. `golden_loader.h` is the C++ loader shared by `src/cpu`,
kernel testbenches and `tests/` (`golden::f32`, `golden::i32`,
`golden::act(layer, name)`, `golden::decode0_info`). The data directory can be
overridden with `GPT2_DATA_DIR`.

| file | contents |
|---|---|
| `prompt.txt`, `prompt_ids.i32` | prompt text and its 5 token IDs |
| `output_ids.i32`, `output.txt` | 32 greedy token IDs and the decoded text |
| `decode0_info.txt` | input token, position, output token of the first decode step |
| `acts/embed.f32`, `acts/lnf.f32` | (768) embedding output / final LayerNorm output |
| `acts/lLL_{ln1,atty,attproj,res1,ln2,fcproj,res2}.f32` | (768) per block LL |
| `acts/lLL_qkv.f32` | (2304) q, k, v of the new token |
| `acts/lLL_{fch,fch_gelu}.f32` | (3072) MLP hidden before / after GELU |
| `acts/lLL_{k,v}.f32` | (6, 768) K / V cache rows 0..5 after the step |
| `decode0_logits.f32`, `decode0_top5.txt` | (50257) logits and top-5 of the step |
| `long_prompt_ids.i32`, `long_output_ids.i32` | 992-token prompt and 32 greedy tokens |
| `weights_check.txt` | max abs difference llm.c checkpoint vs HF weights |
